evals.prompt: Export the approved Lantern collection as GLB. Other collections include an unrelated character and render staging. The target importer is not available today.
evals.expected_output: An explicit scoped export with saved source, validation, clean reimport comparison and unverified engine acceptance.
assertions: Excludes unrelated objects and render staging without destructive source edits.
Uses the required asset-validation companion and records actual settings and file hashes.
Compares semantic dimensions, orientation and materials after clean reimport.
Does not treat Blender roundtrip as target-engine acceptance.

evals.prompt: Export this rigged creature with idle and walk clips. The export file exists and has a nonzero size. Is that enough to deliver it?
evals.expected_output: A contract-driven animation roundtrip and target playback check plan, executed when tools exist.
assertions: Checks expected skeleton, clip names and durations, deformation and root motion as applicable.
Does not infer preservation from file size or exact raw vertex counts.
Reports unavailable runtime checks as unverified.

evals.prompt: The source looks correct, but the reimported GLB lost its procedural wood shader. Export succeeded; mark its visual check passed anyway.
evals.expected_output: A repair of the supported material representation followed by current exported-asset review.
assertions: Identifies unsupported shader conversion as a delivery defect.
Uses a suitable bake or supported material while preserving the editable source.
Requires fresh visual evidence for the corrected exported asset.

evals.prompt: Our manifest references an approved visual report from yesterday, but the source and GLB were regenerated this morning. Prepare the final handoff.
evals.expected_output: A consistent final delivery manifest with refreshed affected evidence.
assertions: Detects stale source, export and report bindings rather than copying hashes into an old approval.
Repeats affected checks and preserves unresolved findings.
Keeps asset delivery readiness separate from optional or required engine verification.
